capture_steps: 1. In Houdini 22.0.400, open the SYNAPSE panel (New Pane Tab Type -> SYNAPSE).
2. On MASTER: screenshot the tab strip pills (DsPill), the verb rail (DsVerb), the palette chips (DsChip), the composer input (DsInput), and a scrollbar handle across curious/expert/ml profiles.
3. Checkout bp3/panel, restart Houdini (panel reload), repeat the same shots.

4. Expected: PIXEL-IDENTICAL. The 5 edits are value-identical token substitutions (SPACE_12=12, SIZE_SMALL=11, SIZE_MICRO=10, SPACE_MD=16, SPACE_LG=24); the generated QSS is proven byte-identical, so any visible difference would indicate an unrelated regression, not this change.

findings.claim: The design system is authoritative in its OWN module and under-adopted everywhere else. designsystem/qss.py is ~99% tokenised (now 100% for substitutable values after this leg); the wider panel holds 492 literal px, 168 off-palette hexes, 69 token-equal inline hexes, 14 literal pt across 34 legacy/feature modules. This is the two-token-system / non-native-fit gap in SYNAPSE_PANEL_DESIGN_REVIEW_H22_LENS.md sec 2.2. The fix is migration, not more tokens.

Byte-identical stylesheet is the leg's core evidence: every token replacing a literal has that literal's exact value, so qss.stylesheet(scale) is unchanged for all five scale steps. This makes the change unfalsifiably non-visual and lets every existing snapshot/density/conformance test stay green trivially.

Naming debt (documented, not fixed - out of designsystem-only territory): SIZE_LABEL is a back-compat alias of SIZE_MICRO (both=10) preferred at 21+ call sites over the canonical (tokens.py:316); OK_SOFT (tokens.py:272) and RADIUS_PILL=14 (tokens.py:488) are defined but have zero live consumers; styles.py imports the LEGACY panel/tokens.py (t.HOVER) alongside designsystem (_ds) - two token authorities. BP2 ruled 'leave the pair' (8+3 pinned importers).

1px hairlines in qss.py (8+ sites: :39,:43,:53,:61,:66,:70,:119,:147,:206,:231,:377,:388) were NOT substituted: there is no numeric width token for 1, and inventing one is a NEW token (outside T3's 'existing token' rule). The rhythm spec sec 2 treats 'hairline 1px, never 2px' as a design constant, so a HAIRLINE/BORDER_PX=1 additive token is a good candidate for a future rhythm-extension leg (spawn), not this pass.

for_ruling.item: Scope interpretation of 'layout files': the change set was confined to designsystem/qss.py (the token-authority stylesheet). synapse_panel.py (a layout module) and the ~30 inline-styled feature modules were AUDITED but not edited - synapse_panel.py because its lifecycle/timer ranges are untouchable and its 13 px are layout margins better migrated with objectNames (BP2 follow-up), and the feature modules because they are outside designsystem/ authority and BP2's 'leave the pair' ruling covers styles.py. If the intended scope was broader (touch feature-module inline styles), that is BP3-INLINE-HEX / BP3-STYLES-MIGRATE, held below.
for_ruling.context: T4 acceptance names 'designsystem/manifests/qss/layout files'; the safe, byte-identical, in-authority reading is designsystem/qss.py. Best achievable verdict is SOUND-WITH-NITS regardless (the gui_required acceptance is structurally UNKNOWN, crucible criterion 4).

Replace 69 token-equal inline hexes across feature modules with token references (agent_health.py:177 #00E676/#FFAB00/#FF3D71 -> GROW/WARN/ERROR; performance_profiler.py:352 #2a2a2a -> PANEL; apex_explainer.py:825/835 -> PANEL/BONE). De-hardcode the 14 literal pt sizes in context_bar.py (the only literal-pt hotspot; the font-floor migration W5L-PANEL never reached it). Route through the SIZE_*/host-floored font path. deps: none. 14 instances.
